summary.name: OpenBitFun
summary.one_liner: OpenBitFun (also called BitFun) is an open-source AI agent system built on a Rust runtime, with cross-device control, composable capabilities, and an interactive desktop app.
use_cases: running AI agent tasks with a live interactive workspace
building community editions of an agent app
using mini apps for presentations, Git insights, or icon design
controlling a task across multiple devices
summary.what_it_does:
The page describes OpenBitFun as an open Agent system with three layers: an Agent Runtime built on a high-performance Rust runtime, an Agent Harness with adaptable execution profiles, and an App GUI. It offers a Device Extension API so the same goal and progress can be kept across connected devices. Users can clone the source from GitHub and start a desktop dev build with pnpm. It also includes Mini Apps such as a PPT app, Git app, icon design tool, and Regex Lab. The Awesome Mac listing describes BitFun as an open-source AI agent where each task gets its own workspace with chat linked to live state.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">open source
notable: Rust-based agent runtime with execution harness profiles
Device Extension API for cross-device task continuity
Per-task interactive workspace with chat linked to live state
Mini Apps for presentations, Git insights, icon design and regex
caveats: Source setup requires cloning the repo and running pnpm commands, so it is aimed at developers
Platform support beyond the Awesome Mac listing is not specified on the page
